item.title: Shuffle Sharding
item.description: Why does Route 53 give your hosted zone four seemingly random name servers instead of the same ones everyone else gets? There are 2,048 of them, arranged into 730 billion possible combinations. That’s what keeps another customer’s failure domain separate from yours.

item.title: The Squirrel Threat Model
item.description: Squirrels have shut down Nasdaq trading twice. Beavers, cows, and sharks have taken down networks too, but misconfiguration, sabotage, and copper theft cause far more damage than any animal ever has.
